subject: Surcharge offsets, milestone credits & packaging for HIPAA/HSM residency
messages:
From: Ayesha Qureshi <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing ask — residency + HSM + audit logs (HIPAA scope)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the platform looks promising. Before we proceed to legal/finance I need clarity on how you would structure pricing for our HIPAA pilot. Key asks: 1) a cap on the one-time implementation/residency activation fee or ability to credit it against committed spend, 2) whether HSM/KMS costs can be amortized or provided as a usage credit, and 3) audit log retention pricing and whether we can avoid the region surcharge during an initial 6-month pilot.

We have a two-phase procurement target: pilot (Q4) then scale (H1 2027). Our procurement lead is asking for explicit milestone credits tied to go-live and sustained usage. Can you propose a path that limits upfront surcharges while keeping Redwood protected?

Best,
Ayesha Qureshi
Head of Procurement, HealthBridge
procurement@healthbridge.ai

---
Attachment: compliance_requirements_HealthBridge.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Qureshi <procurement@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask — residency + HSM + audit logs (HIPAA scope)

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the clear framing. High level we can offer two packaging approaches that map to your pilot/scale plan. I summarized options and the mechanics below and attached a short workbook.

Option A — Pilot-offset path (lower upfront, milestone credits)
- One-time residency activation + HSM setup billed up front but 60% is eligible for a milestone credit: 30% at pilot go-live (30 days), 30% at sustained throughput threshold (3 months at committed QPS).
- Audit log retention (30/90/365 days tiers): pilot tier (30 days) included at no extra cost for first 6 months; beyond that standard per-GB retention applies.
- HSM: pass-through if customer-managed; if Redwood-managed HSM we can offer a per-month seat credit equal to 50% of the setup fee for first 6 months.

Option B — Committed usage rebate (higher commit, lower surcharge)
- Reduce activation fee by 40% in exchange for a 12-month commit at defined throughput. Implementation fee credited over first 6 invoices.
- Audit logs included up to X GB/month depending on commit band.
- KMS/HSM flat monthly seat pricing with volume bands and an annual true-up.

We recommend Option A for your two-phase plan; it minimizes cash outlay in pilot and gives you a clear glide-path to scale credits.

I[0m'd like to align on specific thresholds and craft the language for legal (SOW + MSA) so they can accept the credit mechanics; Ben, can you validate whether the 60% milestone-credit is OK from finance and whether we need to limit the credit to 18 months amortization? Stephanie — can you confirm operational constraints for offering the 6-month no-surcharge audit log window?

I attached a pricing-option-table.xlsx with worked examples.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: pricing-option-table.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask — residency + HSM + audit logs (HIPAA scope)

Vanessa — quick finance take:
- Pilot-offset path OK but we should cap the total refundable credit at 65% of activation to protect us against churn. 60% is fine operationally but set the cap.
- Credits need an expiry (18 months) or a clear invoice-application rule; prefer amortization over invoices (credit ledger) to avoid short-term billing churn.
- For HSM seat credits, limit to first 3 seats at 50% credit for pilot; additional seats billed normally. If HealthBridge grows beyond the pilot bands we can renegotiate at scale.
- For audit log waiver, we can absorb up to 2TB/month for first 3 months for pilot customers in US region; beyond that, standard per-GB applies.

I[0m'm attaching a suggested credit clause we can hand to legal. Vanessa, if Ayesha presses for a full surcharge waiver for 6 months we should push for a conditional waiver tied to an executed commitment (signed SOW + PO) — not a verbal ARR path. Stephanie: can you confirm whether the 2TB pilot threshold is operationally feasible?

Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: finance_credit_clause.txt (text)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask — residency + HSM + audit logs (HIPAA scope)

Ben/Vanessa — ops note:
- 2TB/month audit-log inclusion for 3 months is fine for US regions; need to flag growth above 2TB for capacity planning. We'll add lightweight monitoring and an automated alert to the account when retention bytes exceed pilot thresholds.
- HSM seat credit for up to 3 seats is operationally easy; if HealthBridge opts for Redwood-managed HSM we will need a 30-day lead time to provision and run HSM onboarding (attestation + key rotations).
- Residency activation credit mechanics are fine; confirm whether Finance wants it reflected as an invoice credit line or as a negative line-item on the SOW. Either works but invoice-credit keeps SOW cleaner.

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Operations
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-16T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing ask — residency + HSM + audit logs (HIPAA scope)

Hi Ayesha — appreciative of the quick turnaround. Per our internal alignment we can offer the following pilot-friendly package: 

- Residency & HSM setup: one-time activation fee billed at signature; 60% of that fee is eligible for milestone credits capped at 65% total refundable credit. Credits applied as invoice credits over first 6 invoices or as a ledger credit (your preference).
- Milestones: 30% credit at pilot go-live (within 30 days of signed SOW), 30% at 3 months of sustained throughput (pre-agreed QPS), remaining eligible credit upon conversion to annual commit or 12-month true-up.
- HSM: up to 3 Redwood-managed HSM seats qualify for a 50% monthly credit for the first 3 months. Provisioning requires ~30 days after signature.
- Audit logs: pilot retention (30 days) included at no extra cost for first 3 months; we will absorb up to 2TB/month for the first 3 months in the US region. After the pilot window standard per-GB retention pricing applies.
- Conditions: signed SOW + PO required before credits are instated; credits expire after 18 months if unused.

I attached a redlined SOW and a pricing workbook with worked examples tied to your expected throughput. If this looks acceptable we[0m'll route to legal and finance for the formal SOW + MSA language.

Next steps: 1) Ayesha — confirm whether invoice-credit or ledger-credit is preferred, 2) I[0m'll schedule a short call with your procurement/legal to walk the milestone language (15–20 mins).

Thanks — looking forward to closing the pilot plan.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
